subject: info-acc
title: INFO.DOC.------ACC.FT.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-35 — the section on multi-national corporations as the fastest-developing piece of a greater progressional phenomenon of accelerated western functionalism. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'by solidifying accelerated functionalism in this context, western culture has moved to secure its hold on the total planet. The rise of multi-national corporations is only the fastest development of a much greater progressional phenomenon.' The crossing diagrams how information-documentation structurally meets accelerated-functionalism at the multi-national-corporation scale: INFO-DOC (information documentation — the documented information that supplies the form's working record) crossed with ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). The diagram labels the subject node, the dot the arrow points to, with two stacked labels — (C)INFO-ACC and (R)INT (the reality of intention) — indicating the subject side is the *intersection* of the concept of INFO-ACC and the reality of intention. ACC-FT sits at upper-right at the end of the main line. RT-DY (reality dynamics) rises from the main line, with IST-ACT (isolated activism) branching from it; SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) branches from IST-ACT, ALT-F (alternative functionalism) from SOC-RT-DY, and PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) from ALT-F. POL-P (political policies) drops from the main line; RT-T branches from POL-P, with RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and TRS (transition) branching from RT-T and CN-INFO (controlled information) from RT-INT-TR.
